title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
abstract: arXiv:2611.18130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to finance, creating a need for benchmarks that evaluate their capabilities across financial systems with different regulations and practices. However, existing financial benchmarks provide limited coverage of country-specific financial systems, and they are difficult to keep up to date as released questions leak into training data. We introduce JFinBench, a Japanese financial benchmark comprising 321 examples from the 2026 editions of six regularly administered certification exams covering accounting, tax, financial planning, and banking. To construct it, we develop a human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline in which a coding agent writes exam-specific conversion code and a review page, while a human verifies every example and feeds corrections back to the agent. translated_title: JFinBench：基于最新资格考试的可持续更新的日本金融基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在金融领域的应用日益广泛，这催生了对能够在不同法规与实务的金融体系中评估其能力的基准的需求。然而，现有的金融基准对特定国家金融体系的覆盖有限，而且由于已发布的题目会泄露到训练数据中，它们难以保持时效性。我们提出了JFinBench，一个日本金融基准，包含来自2026年版六项定期举办的资格考试的321个题目，涵盖会计、税务、理财规划和银行业务等领域。为了构建该基准，我们开发了一个人在回路的智能体流水线：编码智能体负责编写针对特定考试的转换代码和审核页面，而人类则验证每个题目并将修正反馈给智能体。该流水线能够适应异构的考试格式，并降低了纳入新考试版本的工作量，从而实现基准的定期更新。
tldr: 该论文提出了JFinBench——一个基于2026年最新版日本资格考试构建、涵盖会计/税务/理财/银行领域的可持续更新金融评测基准，并通过人在回路的智能体流水线大幅降低了纳入新试题、保持基准时效性的成本。
